newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Iddison clarifies options rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Iddison clarifies options rights issue.

text.p: Iddison Group Vietnam on Wednesday said the entitlements or rights to the new options it plans to issue would not be tradeable on the New Zealand Stock Exchange.
As previously announced, Iddison proposes a renounceable rights issue of 11,817,196 October 2000 $0.35 options to all option holders on September 5.

"We advise that, while it is proposed that the new options will be quoted and tradeable on the NZSE, entitlements or rights to the new options although renounceable in the sense that they will be transferable, will not be quoted or tradeable on the

"We have decided not to seek quotation of the rights, as the resultant number of Iddison security classes being traded (ordinary shares, two options and three rights) would lead to confusion and a very real possibility of error."
